title: widget.toml
description: Manifest of a widget package. Editors with TOML schema support (Even Better TOML / Taplo) pick it up from a `#:schema` comment on the first line.

category.description: Gallery section, e.g. "Time". Translated through [strings.<lang>] like name.

variant.description: Which variant of a widget this is, e.g. "Small", shown under its name in a gallery. Translated like name.

author.description: Who made the widget, shown in a gallery.

version.description: Package version, e.g. "1.2.0". A store compares it to offer updates.

homepage.description: The author's page for the widget.

icon.description: Square icon in the package (SVG, or PNG of at least 64x64 px), e.g. "assets/icon.svg". Required in the Calmdesk store.

card.description: Background card drawn by the engine.

shadow.description: Soft drop shadow. The widget window grows by its size.

allow.description: What end users may change in the right-click menu.

option.description: Widget options in the right-click menu. Use them in layout.xml as {opt.<key>}.

values.description: [value, label] pairs. Missing: a Show/Hide toggle with values on/off. Values "Group/name" show in a Group submenu.

kind.description: The user picks a file or folder; bound as its path.

sizes.description: value = [width, height]: picking that value resizes the widget.

strings.description: Translations of the name, category, variant, option labels and {str.<key>} texts, by Windows display language: [strings.ru] "Range" = "Диапазон". The engine translates its own labels.
